meta.method: claude-seo seo-local / seo-backlinks / seo-geo; Firecrawl web search (location India) and scrape; Google Maps data via Firecrawl Alexandria firecrawl-maps businesses/search (10 credits per query, 12 queries); domain ages via claude-seo domain_history.py (whois fallback)
caveats: Justdial and bharatibiz.com refused automated fetches; Justdial ratings and names come from Google result snippets, whose date is unknown. Justdial category pages show different cached figures for the same listing.
IndiaMART 'member since', GST-verified and TrustSEAL flags were not visible in snippets or the one profile scraped, so they are null.

Rainkiss (Netherlands, designer D2C rainwear priced in GBP/EUR) and Indo SMC (SMC/FRP electrical enclosures with a side HDPE tarpaulin listing) are not like-for-like competitors. Shankheshwar Industries (Ahmedabad, HDPE/multilayer tarpaulin and rain poncho fabric) was added as the swap-in. Rainkiss is kept for completeness.

opportunities.name: Google Business Profile: fix and complete
opportunities.why: Fix the address typo, replace 'Business to business service' with specific categories, add products and photos, and get reviews. Divine has 6 reviews against NK Polycross's 42, 4 km away. Divine is not in the top 20 Maps results for 'tarpaulin manufacturer Bavla Ahmedabad'.

opportunities.name: IndiaMART seller listing
opportunities.cost: free basic; paid TrustSEAL / Star or Leading Supplier plans
opportunities.why: IndiaMART category pages appear in all 4 AI-proxy queries, and 7 of the 10 Indian competitors have profiles (Everest 4.2/146, Shalimar 3.5/77, Shankheshwar 3.8/18). Divine has none.

opportunities.name: TradeIndia company listing
opportunities.why: NK Polycross (with a rain-poncho page), Amrut, Everest and Shankheshwar are listed. TradeIndia city pages rank for 'best tarpaulin manufacturers in gujarat' and 'rain poncho supplier bulk india'.

opportunities.name: ExportersIndia listing
opportunities.why: Its 'Best Rain Poncho Manufacturers & Suppliers' page ranks for the bulk-poncho query and its FAQ names suppliers (HM Polymers, Ahmedabad; Tandhan Polyplast). Indo SMC is listed; Divine is not named.

opportunities.name: Justdial and JD Mart: correct the existing listing
opportunities.why: Change the name to Divine Fabtech Industries and the locality to Rupal/Bavla, and fix the 'HDPE' product title. The listing already appears on dozens of Justdial city category pages, so corrections spread widely.

opportunities.name: Bing Places for Business
opportunities.why: Imports from GBP in minutes. Bing data feeds Copilot and ChatGPT local answers (local-seo-signals.md).

opportunities.name: Apple Business Connect (Apple Business)
opportunities.why: Gets the factory onto Apple Maps and Siri for iPhone-using buyers. Uses the same NAP.

opportunities.name: GeM seller registration
opportunities.cost: free registration (vendor assessment / caution money may apply)
opportunities.why: Government departments buy tarpaulins and raincoats through GeM. Divine is already a Udyam-registered small enterprise (UDYAM-GJ-01-0101008), which helps with MSME preferences. This is a sales channel more than a backlink.

opportunities.name: iKhedut (Gujarat Agriculture) tarpaulin subsidy empanelment
opportunities.why: Gujarat's Tadpatri Sahay Yojana (up to Rs 3,000 subsidy per farmer, reopened Jul 2026) runs through iKhedut's public dealer/manufacturer lists. It gives a .gov.in citation and farm demand that matches the farm-pond and crop-cover guides.

opportunities.name: Gujarat State Plastic Manufacturers Association (GSPMA)
opportunities.why: A state plastics body with a public members directory, giving a topical, regional link and trust signal.

opportunities.name: All India Plastics Manufacturers Association (AIPMA)
opportunities.why: The national plastics body (22,000+ members via affiliates, 90% MSME). It has a Gujarat chapter and a member listing.

opportunities.name: Indian Technical Textile Association (ITTA)
opportunities.why: Tarpaulins (Packtech/Agrotech) and rainwear (Protech) are technical textiles. It offers a member directory and event listings. Not checked live in this run.

opportunities.name: Gujarat Chamber of Commerce and Industry (GCCI)
opportunities.why: An Ahmedabad-based chamber with a member directory and events, and a credible local entity signal. Not checked live in this run.

opportunities.name: PLEXCONCIL (Plastics Export Promotion Council)
opportunities.why: Only worth it if Divine exports. It gets the company into exporter directories that overseas buyers and AI answers cite. Not checked live in this run.

opportunities.name: India Plastic Directory
opportunities.why: Its Ahmedabad plastics list already includes firms on the Sarkhej-Bavla highway, a topical and local citation.

opportunities.name: Gujarat Directory
opportunities.why: A free regional manufacturers directory: a consistent-NAP citation for Gujarat searches.

opportunities.name: Infobel India
opportunities.why: A.U. Industries (Auitarp) is listed with its website. It is a cheap citation that data aggregators reuse.

opportunities.name: LinkedIn company page
opportunities.why: Everest Polymers (536 followers), Comsyn and Shalimar have pages, while NK Polycross only has employees. It is a sameAs entity anchor that AI systems use.

opportunities.name: YouTube channel (factory and product videos)
opportunities.why: In seo-geo's data, YouTube mentions have the strongest correlation with AI citations (~0.74). NK Polycross, Everest and Comsyn have videos; Divine has none. Ideas: a GSM comparison, a poncho fold demo, a factory walk-through.

opportunities.why: No Divine page shows up in Facebook search results, and the site links only a /share/ redirect. NK Polycross's page has 274 likes and posts weekly. Use the real page URL in sameAs.

ai_visibility.query: best rain poncho manufacturers in india

gbp_checklist.how: 'Manufacturer' is set and is the primary used by almost every top-ranking Ahmedabad tarpaulin listing (Ambica Traders, Noble Brothers, NK Polycross). Keep it unless the GBP editor offers a tarpaulin-specific category. No 'Tarpaulin supplier/manufacturer' category appeared on any of the roughly 40 competitor profiles checked, so check in the editor before assuming it exists.

Replace 'Business to business service' with categories seen on competitors' profiles: 'Polythene and plastic sheeting supplier', 'Plastic Products Supplier', 'Fabric product manufacturer', 'Protective clothing supplier' (for ponchos) and optionally 'Wholesaler'.

'DIVINE FABTECH INDUSTRIES' matches the GST trade name. Do not copy competitors' keyword-stuffed names (e.g. 'NK Polycross LLP | Multilayer Cross Laminated Tarpaulin'): that breaks Google's guidelines and can get the listing suspended.

Correct it to 'Survey No 710-711, Village Rupal, Bavla, Jivapura, Gujarat 382220'. The current value runs '710-711' and 'Village' together and repeats 'Rupal'. The pin (22.80768, 72.36382) looks right, so reuse it as geo in LocalBusiness schema.
Already https://www.divinefabtech.com/. Optionally add ?utm_source=google&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gbp to see GBP traffic separately in GA4.
Set Mon-Sat 09:00-18:00 to match the site, and add Diwali and other holiday closures as special hours. 'Open at time of search' is a ranking factor.
The listing is live with reviews and owner-editable fields appear updated, but check the dashboard for the verified state. No duplicate Divine listing turned up in Maps search.

Name multilayer tarpaulin (Indoline, 90-200 GSM, custom 70-200 for 2-ton orders) and rain ponchos (5 colours), factory in Bavla, factory-direct bulk supply across India. No URLs or promotional claims.

Add one product per line with photo, short spec and price range: Indoline multilayer tarpaulin 90/120/150/200 GSM, rain poncho (5 colours), raincoat pant, recyclable poncho, truck cover, farm-pond liner. Link each to its site page.

gbp_checklist.item: Photos (10+ across types) and monthly freshness
gbp_checklist.how: Upload logo, cover, factory exterior with signage, machines and production line, stock and rolls, each poncho colour, dispatch and loading, and team. Add 2-4 new photos a month.
Upload a 20-40 s factory clip and a poncho demo. Reuse the same clips on YouTube and Instagram.

Keep the address visible (visitors come to the factory). Add service areas for the main Gujarat cities the site targets (Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot) and set any applicable attributes.
Post weekly: monsoon poncho stock, new GSM or colour, bulk-order offers, links to the guides. Posts don't directly raise rankings but keep the listing active and can surface as post justifications.
6 reviews at 3.7 vs NK Polycross 42 at 4.5 (4 km away). Target 10+ within 6 weeks (Sterling Sky's 'magic 10'), then 3-4 a month with no gap longer than about 3 weeks, so roughly 45 within 12 months.

Use the direct link https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=ChIJY9QNbzyVXjkRvFc3HBQmrh0. (1) Send a WhatsApp message to each buyer 3-5 days after delivery, (2) put a QR code on invoices and dispatch slips, (3) ask repeat dealers and contractors in person, (4) suggest they mention the product and city. Ask every customer, with no gating and no incentives (Google policy). Ask for Justdial ratings second.
Reply to all 6 existing reviews (especially the low ones) within 48 hours, and to every new one, aiming for an 80%+ response rate. Keep replies specific and courteous, mentioning the product.
Google retired the Q&A API (Nov 2025) and is phasing out public Q&A, so put buyer FAQs on the site (FAQ content exists) and answer common questions in the description and review replies.

Add Instagram and the canonical Facebook page URL in GBP. In site schema sameAs, add the GBP Maps URL (place_id ChIJY9QNbzyVXjkRvFc3HBQmrh0), the Justdial URL, and IndiaMART/LinkedIn/YouTube once created.
